segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [quiet aquarium water bubbling] [softly] Lie down and arrange blankets or supports until stillness feels possible. Imagine a moonlit aquarium after closing, blue and quiet, with no visitor left to impress.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the whole body resting on the floor or bed. Make a simple intention to remain gently aware while every unnecessary muscle clocks out.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Bring attention to the right thumb... index finger... middle finger... ring finger... little finger... palm... back of the hand... wrist.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Move through the right forearm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit... right waist... hip... thigh... knee.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the right shin... calf... ankle... heel... sole... top of the foot... big toe... second... third... fourth... little toe. Let the whole right side become heavy.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Now the left thumb... index finger... middle finger... ring finger... little finger... palm... back of the hand... wrist.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Move through the left forearm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit... left waist... hip... thigh... knee.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the left shin... calf... ankle... heel... sole... top of the foot... big toe... second... third... fourth... little toe. The whole left side releases.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice both heels... backs of the legs... buttocks... lower back... middle back... upper back... shoulder blades, spreading like rays across the aquarium floor.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Bring awareness to the lower belly... navel... upper belly... lower ribs... chest... collarbones... and the soft hollow of the throat.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the back of the neck... base of the skull... back of the head... crown. Let the scalp loosen beneath an imagined current of cool blue water.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Now soften the jaw hinges... lower jaw... chin... lower lip... upper lip... corners of the mouth. Let the teeth separate.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Release the tongue from its root to its tip... underside and upper surface... allow it to rest broad and quiet in the mouth.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the right cheek... left cheek... right ear... left ear... nose... nostrils... and the faint movement of air passing through.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Soften the right eyelid... left eyelid... right eye... left eye... the tiny muscles behind both eyes. Let seeing switch off for now.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Release the space between the eyebrows... each eyebrow... temples... forehead... hairline... and the entire scalp once more.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the whole face at once, smooth as glass after the last ripple. The throat, shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, pelvis, legs, and feet all rest together.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [reassuringly] Nothing needs to happen. If thoughts swim past like silver fish, let them cross the blue room without following.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Experience the whole body as one quiet shape, surrounded by space and supported from below. Rest here without searching for sleep.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Deepen the breath. Move fingers and toes, roll the head gently if comfortable, and open the eyes when the moonlit room feels near again.
